parts.name: Temporalis tendon
parts.function_note: The muscle's broad, fan-shaped origin from the entire temporal fossa converges as it descends deep to the zygomatic arch into a single strong tendon inserting on the coronoid process -- a fan-to-cord convergence pattern architecturally similar to (though not modeled with separate parts here, unlike) the quadriceps and rotator cuff tendons' documented internal layering.
parts.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell)

function: The convergent tendon of one of the four muscles of mastication; its extensive fan-shaped origin funneling to a single narrow coronoid insertion is a clear architectural example of a fan-to-cord (convergent) muscle-tendon unit.
source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
